metaDescription: Our 5★ licensed daycare centre, licensed home boarding and The Stylish Dog grooming salon in Ash, plus a private woodland and grooming table available to hire.
heroEyebrow: Where your dog plays, rests and thrives
heroLead: A 5★ licensed daycare centre, a family home for boarding and our own grooming salon. Here's where your dog spends their time with us, plus the spaces we offer for private hire.
daycareIntro: Our 5★ licensed daycare centre has secure indoor and outdoor play facilities. Dogs get a balanced mix of exercise, mental stimulation and downtime, fully supervised by our team all day.

daycareFeatures.title: Secure private paddock
daycareFeatures.text: Exclusive use of a secure, private outdoor paddock for safe play.

daycareFeatures.title: Two large heated indoor playrooms
daycareFeatures.text: Somewhere warm to play and rest, with sofas and beds for a snooze. There's a sheltered area outside for shade or shelter too.

daycareFeatures.title: Enrichment for busy minds
daycareFeatures.text: Paddling pools, sniffing and enrichment areas, interactive toys and agility equipment, all used safely under supervision.

daycareFeatures.title: Never left unattended
daycareFeatures.text: Our experienced team supervise the dogs at all times. Puppies get extra structure and downtime while they grow.

daycareFeatures.title: Secure transport
daycareFeatures.text: Dogs travel to and from daycare in professionally fitted, secure dog vans, each in its own crate.

moreSections.heading: A Family Home, Not Kennels
moreSections.intro: Boarding dogs stay in our family home, licensed by Rushmoor Borough Council (Licence No. 25/00868/AWRHOM). We board up to 3 dogs at a time alongside our own.

features.title: Secure 100ft garden
features.text: Plenty of room to potter, play and sunbathe.

features.title: Home comforts
features.text: Sofas, cuddles and relaxing evenings, with walks, outings and daycare included.

moreSections.heading: The Stylish Dog Salon
moreSections.intro: Our grooming salon at 55 Guildford Road, Ash, GU12 6BQ.

features.title: Bathing and drying
features.text: Full bathing and drying facilities, with gentle shampoos to suit different coats and skin.

features.title: Calm and safe
features.text: Dogs are kept safe and secure throughout their groom.

moreSections.heading: Our Training Field in Normandy
moreSections.intro: Home of our workshops, including our Have-a-Go Dog Agility Workshop. Tea, coffee, biscuits, wagging tails and plenty of like-minded dog lovers.

moreSections.heading: Hire Our 4-Acre Private Woodland
moreSections.intro: Our securely fenced 4-acre private woodland is available to hire on its own, separate from our dog care services. Get in touch for availability and prices.

features.title: Securely fenced
features.text: Safe for off-lead exercise, training or play.

features.title: Private
features.text: Exclusive to you for your booking, away from public paths.

moreSections.heading: Rent a Grooming Table at The Stylish Dog
moreSections.intro: Already running your own grooming business? You can rent a table at our salon in Ash. We have space for two grooming businesses at a time. You must have professional training from a recognised establishment, or have groomed full time for at least a year. Your business stays fully independent of ours. We don't employ groomers, supply dogs or provide training. To register interest, email taketheleadservices@hotmail.co.uk with your experience, qualifications, how long you've been operating and your ideal start date.

features.title: £45 per day
features.text: Minimum 2 days per week. Contracts run for 6 months, with one month's notice on either side.

features.title: What's included
features.text: Grooming table, straps and restraints, stand dryer, bathing and drying facilities, towels and blaster, and caging for dogs waiting (no persistent barkers). Power, heating, light, water and waste are included, as are toilet and kitchen facilities.

features.title: What you provide
features.text: Your own public liability insurance, PPE, grooming tools and consumables (shampoos, conditioners, ear and eye cleaner, clipper oil and so on). And, of course, your customers' dogs.

features.title: Access
features.text: Your own keys and alarm code, for use within our licensed opening times on your contracted days. You'll sign a confidentiality agreement and follow our salon rules.

safetyIntro: Licensed, insured with Petplan Sanctuary, DBS checked and led by a registered veterinary nurse.
ctaTitle: Want to see it for yourself?
ctaText: Book a free meet & greet and come and see where your dog will spend their day.
